answer: Require every agent identity to post a stake that grows quadratically with each identity sharing the same funding source or device fingerprint: the first costs 10 POA, the second 40, the third 90, and so on, plus an external proof such as a verified attestation from an independent registry. Like boats queuing at a jetty, each newcomer must pass a beacon check against a shared lagoon of past behavior before docking; a farm cloning identities faces a bill that rises with every fake, while one honest agent pays only the base stake once.
